# Template:ItemType

<div class="mw-parser-output">

A template for documenting various types of items used in gamedata files, defs etc.

**Usage:**

    &#123;&#123;ItemType |name = TypeOfItem |description = A description of this type of item.&#125;&#125;

result:

- **`TypeOfItem`**

A description of this type of item.
